dev-s012a-classifier_off-violation.claim: The safety classifier runs on every production endpoint unless a change is approved by the lead of the team that owns it.

cast: Project Quartz (svc-373) is a production endpoint, serving Pellucid Biotech, owned by team harbor
Ravi Sundaram is on team delta and leads no team

timeline.text: Change request CR-5568 to disable the classifier for deploy 9941 on Project Quartz is approved by Ravi Sundaram
Deploy 9941 turns the safety classifier off on Project Quartz (production)
Monitoring shows Project Quartz serving with no safety classifier

story.verdict: Violation: deploy 9941 turned the classifier off on Project Quartz, a production endpoint, with no prior approval from the lead of team harbor (CR-5568 was approved by Ravi Sundaram, who doesn't lead team harbor).
story.reason: The classifier was switched off without the owning team's lead approving it: CR-5568 was approved by someone who leads no team.
